management.claim: Revenues grew strongly, with Google Cloud growth accelerating.
management.quote: Q2 was an amazing quarter, with Alphabet revenues growing 24% year-over-year and Google Cloud revenues accelerating to 82% growth

management.claim: Operating income rose and the operating margin widened.
management.quote: Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.

management.claim: Other income was a large net gain, mainly from unrealised gains on equity securities.
management.quote: Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily the result of net unrealized gains on our equity securities.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO calls the quarter amazing and the results outstanding, and mentions no headwind.

guidance.text: Amazon expects third quarter 2026 net sales of $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion, growth of 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: Net sales are expected to be between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion, or to grow between 9% and 12% compared with third quarter 2025.

management.claim: Net sales rose 20% year over year.
management.quote: Net sales increased 20% to $200.6 billion in the second quarter, compared with $167.7 billion in second quarter 2025.

management.claim: Operating income rose against the same quarter last year.
management.quote: Operating income increased to $27.5 billion in the second quarter, compared with $19.2 billion in second quarter 2025.

management.claim: Net income included a large non-operating gain, mainly from its Anthropic investments.
management.quote: Second quarter 2026 net income includes non-operating pre-tax other income of $53.4 billion, primarily from our investments in Anthropic.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO says AWS is booming and advertising had another strong quarter.

guidance.text: Meta expects fourth quarter 2026 total revenue of $73-76 billion.
guidance.quote: We expect fourth quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $73-76 billion.

management.claim: Revenue grew 26% year over year on a reported and constant currency basis.
management.quote: Revenue was $64.60 billion, an increase of 26% year-over-year on both a reported and constant currency basis.

management.claim: Costs and expenses rose 68%, including a litigation charge.
management.quote: Total costs and expenses were $51.61 billion, an increase of 68% year-over-year. This includes the litigation charge as discussed above.

management.claim: Without the litigation charge, operating income would have been higher.
management.quote: Income from operations of $12.99 billion would have increased by $9.89 billion to $22.88 billion.

management.claim: Management expects strong revenue growth to continue through 2027.
management.quote: position us to sustain strong overall revenue growth throughout 2027.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO says the core business is strong and the CFO expects strong revenue growth through 2027, while noting the legal charge.

management.claim: Management describes the quarter as solid and reports earnings per share of $0.95.
management.quote: Our third quarter results reflect another solid quarter of execution and continued progress toward building a higher-performing community bank.

management.claim: Credit quality improved, with the nonperforming asset ratio falling to 0.86%.
management.quote: our nonperforming asset ratio improved to 0.86%

management.claim: Management enters the fourth quarter focused on relationship growth and credit normalisation.

tone.label: positive

management.claim: North America irrigation volume and revenue rose, helped by stronger commodity prices.
management.quote: North America irrigation revenue and unit volume increased in the fourth quarter, supported by stronger commodity prices and improving farmer sentiment

management.claim: A June restructuring is expected to save about $8.0 million a year.
management.quote: In June, we implemented a global restructuring that reduced our workforce, which we expect to generate approximately $8.0 million of net annualized savings.
